subject: Scale-up commit onboarding and latency shield
messages:
From: Samuel Lee <samuel@vectorretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@vectorretail.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Traffic spike prep + potential commit increase

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well — we’ve been reviewing our Q2 roadmap and expect a 2.5x spike in peak traffic for three weekends in May (promo + new feature). Our current hosted plan is hitting soft throttle during peak convolution.

Can Redwood support a short-term commit uplift and an add-on that reduces cold-start/latency tail for high-concurrency bursts? We’re interested in a path that avoids long-term penalty if the spikes subside, and would like pricing and any ops constraints.

Thanks — Samuel
Samuel Lee
Head of Platform, VectorRetail

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Lee <samuel@vectorretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Traffic spike prep + potential commit increase

Samuel — thanks for the heads up. We can absolutely support a short-term uplift and a latency-focused add-on (we call it "Latency Shield") that keeps cold-starts to a minimum during high concurrency windows. High level options: 

- Temporary commit ladder: 1-month uplift to a higher monthly commit with prorated charges and the option to revert after the promo window.
- Burst credits: pre-purchased burst tokens to cover delta usage with a higher per-token rate but no long-term commitment.
- Latency Shield: a paid ops + reserved-warm pool that pins a small dedicated capacity to your account for each peak weekend (reduces p99 tail by ~40–60ms in our benchmarks).

Next steps I propose: technical sync with Karthik (runtime/ops) and Vanessa (billing) to map a concrete schedule and draft an amendment. Are you available Thu or Fri this week for a 30-min call? I attached a rough commit schedule and ops notes.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_s@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0189

Attachments: 2028-03-30_vectorretail_commit_schedule.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Lee <samuel@vectorretail.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Mar 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Traffic spike prep + potential commit increase

Samuel — quick technical notes ahead of our call: 

1) Workload profile: please confirm typical sequence length and chat vs. single-turn generation during promos. If average seq len < 128, we can route you to an optimized kernel with lower memory headroom.
2) Latency Shield design: we’ll provision a reserved warm pool (N small GPUs) during each weekend window and enable aggressive prefix caching + eager KV warmup. There’s a ~2–4 hour warmup to reach optimal cache hit-rate; we recommend bringing pool up 4 hours before expected ramp.
3) Autoscale fallback: in addition to reserved pool, policy will allow overflow to dedicated burst band with soft-failover.

I attached an ops worksheet with the recommended pool sizes based on the traffic estimates in Hannah’s schedule. On the call we’ll finalize apertures and confirm the cost delta.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-latency-shield-ops-notes.xlsx

From: Samuel Lee <samuel@vectorretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@vectorretail.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Apr 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Traffic spike prep + potential commit increase

Thanks all — the ops worksheet looks reasonable. Confirming sequence length is ~96 tokens average for promo generators and we hit ~6k concurrent streams at peak last year. We’re OK with the 4-hour warmup.

We’d like to proceed with:
- One-month commit ladder: bump to 3x current monthly commit for May, prorated to active days.
- Latency Shield reserved pool for the three promo weekends (bring up 4 hours ahead).
- 50k burst credits as a safety net.

Can you send an amendment for a short-term addendum and a DocuSign we can sign this week? We need billing details for our finance team (GL code, invoice cadence).

Samuel
